name_reason: Already compliant: data_fd2_ prefix for game global data, domain 'chapter', descriptor encodes a meaningful chapter ID (ch05, in the 01-30 range -- must be preserved, not address residue), the cutscene phase (end_scene), the per-character attribute (char_facing), and the data type (table/array). No Ghidra address residue (no _520dd or hex suffix matching its own address). Name accurately reflects both purpose (sprite facing-direction table) and aggregate type (7-element byte array).
purpose: Chapter 5 (Sera Village / 塞拉村) end-scene per-character sprite facing-direction table for the 7 characters staged in the recruit cutscene (recruit char #10, 僧侶瑪琳).
logic_summary: Third of three parallel 7-byte tables (X @ 0x520CF, Y @ 0x520D6, facing @ 0x520DD). The sole reader fd2_chapter_05_end @ 0x231F9 block-copies all 7 bytes onto an on-stack scene block (MOV ESI,0x520DD; MOV EDI,ESP; MOVSD/MOVSW/MOVSB), one byte per element, with no struct stride/wider access/sign extension, then passes that block as the 3rd (facing-direction) argument to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro @ 0x233C6.
element_semantics: Each element [i] is the initial sprite facing-direction code for staged character i in the chapter-5 end cutscene. Values are small direction codes in range 1..3 (raw bytes {2,2,2,3,3,1,1}).
notes: Verified: read_memory @ 0x520DD = 02 02 02 03 03 01 01 = {2,2,2,3,3,1,1}, byte-identical to the src initializer (lines 326-328). xrefs_to: exactly one READ (0x23229, the MOVSD) + one DATA (0x23224, the MOV ESI immediate that loads the table address), both in fd2_chapter_05_end; no writer -> const confirmed. Disassembly of fd2_chapter_05_end @ 0x231F9 confirms the src comment's asm (MOV EDI,ESP == LEA EDI,[ESP+0x0]; MOV ESI,0x520DD; MOVSD/MOVSW/MOVSB) and that the facing block at [ESP+0x0] is pushed last (LEA EAX,[ESP+0x38]) as the 3rd arg to 0x233C6. src comment block (chtab.c lines 306-328) is already a precise final-conclusion comment with correct address/size/caller/asm/semantics and no phase/date/process narrative -> kept as-is. Ghidra data plate was absent (null); created a concise src-conclusion plate via run_script_inline PLATE_COMMENT (MCP set_plate_comment fails for data) and saved with save_program. Compile-error noise in run_script_inline output is from pre-existing stale .java files in the ghidra_scripts dir, not from this inline script (which completed successfully and verified the plate landed).
